_meta.purpose: The ratchet. Every number here was MEASURED on 2026-09-06, at the corpus's first build, and committed as the worst acceptable value. build_index.py --check fails when a run is worse than a floor.
_meta.why_it_is_here_and_not_in_INDEX.json: INDEX.json is generated by build_index.py and rewritten on every build. A floor kept there would reset itself to whatever the current run happens to be, which is not a floor — it is a mirror. Floors are AUTHORED, and this file is the authored side.
_meta.direction: Worse than a floor FAILS. Better than a floor is REPORTED as 'floor can drop' and stops there — a human commits the tighter value with a reason and a date. Auto-tightening would let one lucky run lock in a number nobody chose, and one bad page afterwards would then read as a regression.
_meta.what_it_does_not_do: Nothing here measures whether a page is any good. These are coverage and hygiene floors only; the golden set measures reachability, not answer quality.
_meta.a_note_on_starting_clean: Unlike the upstream vault this was ported from, this corpus starts with authority and disposition on every page and with related reciprocity checked, so those floors begin at zero rather than at the full corpus size. That is a consequence of the schema existing before the pages did, not of any greater discipline, and it means these floors can only be defended — there is no backfill credit to spend.

pages_min.reason: Measured corpus size at first build. A drop means pages were deleted — possibly correctly, but never silently.

orphans_max.reason: An orphan is a page nobody will find. Zero is the standing state.

nonreciprocal_related_max.reason: SCHEMA.md declares `related` bidirectional. A one-way entry is invisible from the side that was never edited, which is exactly the failure mode a declared convention does not catch. Checked rather than trusted.

dangling_related_max.reason: A `related` entry naming a page that does not exist is a typo or a deletion nobody followed through. Both are silent.

unclassified_ip_max.reason: ip_class is required on every page and is the field with the longest fuse — nothing downstream re-reads the original, so a book mislabelled `public` becomes paraphrasable months later with no remaining signal.

untyped_max.reason: An untyped page is absent from by_type and therefore from every routed read.

missing_authority_max.reason: Every page carries it from the first build. In this domain the field is load-bearing rather than hygienic: the sport's coaching assertion and its research findings are constantly conflated, and this is the only field that keeps them apart.

missing_disposition_max.reason: Required on `source` and `concept` pages; `entity` pages are exempt by SCHEMA.md. Zero from the first build. The number to watch is not this one but the ratio of `sharpened` to `gap` in by_disposition — a corpus that only ever records gaps is a reading list.

allowed_empty_lenses._note: Tags with zero pages that are KNOWN and accepted. This file is where that judgement lives, so it stays checkable instead of being asserted in prose: an empty tag NOT listed here is an error, and a listed tag that gains a page is reported so the row gets removed. Deliberately carries no total — a count in a sentence is the thing this file exists to stop drifting.
allowed_empty_lenses.aid-station-crew: Uncovered at first build. Crew briefing, drop-bag design and per-stop time budgeting are named inside pacing-by-effort and the-dnf-decision but have no page. Ordinary gap, closable from practitioner sources without new research.
allowed_empty_lenses.altitude: Uncovered at first build. The environment lens grounds via heat-adaptation so it is not starved, but an altitude question currently reaches heat pages. Closable from the existing physiology literature.
allowed_empty_lenses.caffeine-supplements: Uncovered at first build. Referenced in sleep-and-the-night as part of a night plan with no page behind it. The evidence base here is unusually good and the omission is purely one of effort.
allowed_empty_lenses.cold-weather: Uncovered at first build. Hypothermia appears in the-dnf-decision's non-negotiable stop list with nothing behind it, which is the worst kind of gap — a rule with no reasoning attached.
allowed_empty_lenses.foot-care: Uncovered at first build. Blisters and macerated feet end more races than the literature's silence suggests, and almost all the knowledge is practitioner-held.
allowed_empty_lenses.gear-kit: Uncovered at first build. Partly deliberate: gear advice dates fast and is the most commercially captured content in the sport. A page here would need to be about SELECTION METHOD rather than about products.
allowed_empty_lenses.goal-setting: Uncovered at first build. motivation-adherence grounds via motivation and habit-adherence so the lens is not starved, but season-level goal setting is the entry point to every other decision and has no page.
allowed_empty_lenses.race-selection: Uncovered at first build. Same lens as above. Choosing the wrong race is an error no amount of good training corrects, and this corpus currently cannot help with it.
allowed_empty_lenses.return-to-run: Uncovered at first build. THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL EMPTY TAG HERE. injury-health grounds via four other tags so nothing fails, but return-to-run is the decision an injured athlete gets wrong at the highest cost, and a lens that improvises on it will produce something that reads exactly like advice.

allowed_starved_lenses._note: A lens whose EVERY mapped tag is empty. This is the serious one: unlike an empty tag it never surfaces at runtime, because the lens does not fail — it improvises, and its note reads exactly like a grounded one. A golden question routed only to lenses listed here is reported short rather than failed; a starved lens NOT listed here fails the build. AT FIRST BUILD THIS LIST IS EMPTY — every one of the fifteen lenses has at least one reachable page, which was a deliberate constraint on which pages got written first. Two lenses are nonetheless thin enough to name: race-logistics reaches exactly one page, and motivation-adherence reaches two. Neither is starved and both are one deletion away from it.
